text: Tim Culpan Oct 26, 2026 7 1 Share Good Evening from Taipei, Anthropic just released its S1 — the pre-IPO form which includes its prospectus. This is a quick overview for you to skim through and share. Included is a brief income statement for the first six months of 2026. Read on for that and more. IMO, the most interesting data is in the table I compiled at the very end. This article is free for all to read. But you need to be a Culpium subscriber to get access.
